source.figurePipeline: Literal Cell 5 makes exact/reference sweeps; literal Cell 6 splits the 17 maps into 6, 6 and 5 rows.
provenanceCautions: Fresh small blocks were generated directly from the current map registry and raw assembly. Historical appendix figures were not regenerated or validated.
Current Cell 1 defaults to square N=10,…,120, while the supplied appendix prose describes N=10,…,70. Current reference sizes derive as N=130, M=140.

Current notebook reference normalisation reads real/imag keys, but the backend reference records emit value/target and target_real_float/target_imag_float. The full reference pipeline was excluded from this export.
The backend reference_mass_error fields currently repeat the Gram defect. Toy mass defects below are independently computed from the first matrix row.

construction.midpointDefinition: A0 is the entrywise nearest 2^-40 dyadic to the computed N=3,M=16 raw Legendre block.
construction.targetDefinition: A1 is the entrywise nearest 2^-40 dyadic to the computed N=3,M=32 raw Legendre block.
construction.freezingBoundary: Freezing DEFINES exact toy matrices. It does not certify the mpmath computations, their quadrature error, an exact Galerkin block, or a transfer operator.
construction.coordinates: Euclidean norm on C^3 in the raw L2-normalized Legendre coordinate convention; no Hardy gauge transport is claimed.
construction.candidateStep: SciPy real Schur supplies candidates only. Q and the upper triangle of T are frozen to 2^-40 dyadics; the entire surrogate residual is checked exactly.
construction.conditioningProof: delta=||Q^T Q-I||_infinity<1 implies Q invertible and kappa_2(Q)<=sqrt((1+delta)/(1-delta)); qCondition is rounded upward by integer square-root comparison.
construction.schurProof: S=QTQ^-1 and ESchur=A0-S are exact rational matrices; schurResidual^2 >= sum_ij |ESchur_ij|^2.
construction.contour: Gamma={z:|z-1|=1/8}. All frozen T diagonal entries are real, so d_i=abs(abs(1-t_ii)-1/8) is exact.
construction.triangularProof: U_ii=1/d_i; U_ij=sum_(k=i+1..j) |t_ik| U_kj / d_i. Then ||(zI-T)^-1||_2<=sqrt(||U||_1||U||_infinity)<=triangularInverse for every z on Gamma.
construction.gate1Proof: surrogate <= 1/(qCondition*triangularInverse); schurResidual<surrogate; 0<midpoint<=surrogate-schurResidual. The Schur-to-midpoint homotopy preserves the contour count.
construction.entryBox: E=A1-A0 exactly. Centered at A0, entry rectangle half-widths are |E_ij|+2^-40 in the real direction and 2^-40 in the imaginary direction. This is a chosen exact toy enclosure, not Arb-validated PF quadrature uncertainty.
construction.liftProof: B=A1 direct-sum 0 on C^4 exactly. d(Gamma,0)=7/8; lift=min(resolved,7/8). Zero is outside the closed disk, so this lift adds no enclosed eigenvalue.
construction.couplingDefinition: D_0,3=D_3,0=1/100, all other entries zero; L=B+D on C^4.
construction.operatorGateProof: operatorAllowance<lift and operatorGain=operatorAllowance/lift<1 imply s_Gamma(L)>=lift-operatorAllowance>0. The B+tD homotopy preserves rank one.
construction.tailBoundary: D is a defined abstract finite toy coupling. No bound on the true PF operator tail, Hardy geometry, or infinite-dimensional truncation error is supplied.
construction.diagnosticBoundary: pointwise and numeric fields are binary64 display data only. Certificate claims are the rational equalities and inequalities in exact and bounds.
